evaluator_predicate.evaluator_predicate_description: The evaluator tested whether the requested Taodian order was completed by checking for an order callback and reported that no callback record existed.

chains.rationale: The evaluator directly reports the absence of the order callback used to verify the frozen taodian_order_completed predicate. The continuous reuse-target-or-later trace shows the candidate closing the image viewer and then participating in the same open-image/close-viewer loop through step 50, without reaching Taodian or completing an order. This known UNBROKEN_LOOP contribution remained unrecovered and plausibly contributed to the verified failure. However, the frozen static-image-product-link-misinterpretation defect independently suffices to explain failure, so strong linkage is unavailable.

summary: The evaluator directly confirms that no order-completion callback was recorded. The candidate remained an unrecovered part of a continuous image-viewer navigation loop, plausibly contributing to the failed order predicate, while a frozen independent product-link misinterpretation defect also sufficiently explains failure.
